name: The Labyrinth's Heart
source:
After investigating a cult, the private investigator Ryo finds themselves in living eldritch dimension that has as much as a bone to pick with the cult as they do. But how much is Ryo willing to risk to take down this cult? 

[From [url=https://thelynster.itch.io/the-labyrinths-heart]Itch.io[/url]]
